[Act: gst
 Chapter: Advance Ruling
 Section: 106::Procedure of Authority, Appellate Authority and National Appellate Authority.
]


The Authority or the Appellate Authority 3[or the National Appellate Authority] shall, subject to the provisions of this Chapter, have power to regulate its own procedure.
